derived_from.section: Work package W4 — Immutable outcome and feedback ledger
derived_from.note: Refinement of the approved plan section into machine-readable criteria. No product scope is added, removed, or reinterpreted; every criterion traces to a plan line.

commit: feat(optimizer): add immutable outcomes and append-only feedback
campaign_invariants_in_force: additive schema only; no destructive migration and no production backfill
no production DB writes; disposable/test DBs only
SQLite and Postgres parity for every added column
strict TDD: one failing test, run it, implement only enough to pass, rerun

criteria.plan_line: exactly one mutable-finalized outcome row per root run, guarded by a unique root session ID
criteria.text: A root run has at most one outcome row. The uniqueness is enforced by the schema on root session id, not only by service logic, so a concurrent second finalizer cannot create a second row.

criteria.plan_line: append-only feedback events with source and confidence
criteria.text: Feedback rows are insert-only. There is no update or delete path in the repository, and a contradictory later verdict is retained alongside the earlier one rather than replacing it.

criteria.plan_line: exact links to session/root session, scheduled occurrence, proposal/experiment variant, profile/config revision, and attribution JSON
criteria.text: An outcome row carries session id, root session id, scheduled occurrence, proposal/experiment variant, the profile/config revision in force, and an attribution JSON blob.

criteria.plan_line: separate objective, explicit-user, and inferred evidence fields
criteria.text: Objective evidence, explicit user verdict, and inferred verdict occupy distinct fields. Reading one can never be mistaken for another.

criteria.plan_line: repository supports idempotent finalization and append-only feedback insertion; explicit feedback is never overwritten by inferred feedback
criteria.text: Finalizing the same root run twice is idempotent and yields the same row. An inferred verdict arriving after an explicit user verdict does not replace it; the explicit verdict remains the authoritative field.

criteria.plan_line: deterministic finalizer maps terminal status plus objective artifact/error/approval evidence to success | partial | failure | inconclusive
criteria.text: The finalizer is a pure deterministic function of terminal status and objective evidence. No LLM call and no heuristic prose scoring participates. Absent or contradictory evidence yields inconclusive, never a guessed success.

criteria.plan_line: feedback API accepts success | partial | failure plus optional reason and actor; validates ownership/auth using existing route conventions
criteria.text: The route accepts exactly those three verdicts, rejects anything else, and enforces ownership/auth the same way sibling routes do.

criteria.plan_line: terminal hooks create/finalize one ledger record without blocking the user turn. Duplicate terminal events remain idempotent.
criteria.text: The terminal hook is fire-and-forget with respect to the user turn and never throws into it. Duplicate terminal events for the same root run produce one row.

criteria.plan_line: Record exact invoked tool/skill revisions only when attributable; store unknown explicitly rather than inventing attribution.
criteria.text: Attribution records exact revisions when they are known, and an explicit unknown marker when they are not. A missing revision is never silently defaulted to a plausible value.

criteria.plan_line: Ensure prompts, tool arguments/outputs, credentials, and secret-like values are not copied into the ledger.
criteria.text: No prompt text, tool argument, tool output, credential, or secret-like value is written to the ledger tables. A test asserts this over a fixture containing all of those.

acceptance_gates: One terminal outcome per root run.
Explicit user verdict cannot be replaced by inference.
Exact revisions are attributed when known and marked unknown otherwise.
No raw prompts/tool payloads/secrets enter the new tables.
explicitly_out_of_scope: Desktop feedback controls beyond the API contract (plan: Deferred by design).
Any consumption of the ledger by an experiment gate — that is W6.
